title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-kevin-ong-2026-03-09
content:
Quick triage notes (personal scratchpad) - working through customer-reported dashboard/metrics issues.

Context:
- Customer: Acme Analytics (CS-4321) reported missing latency breakdowns and 500 spikes on /v1/generate route in the Console dashboard.
- Ticket OBS-1284 created to correlate observability gaps. Slack thread: #obs-frontend (link pinned).

Immediate observations:
- Grafana panel "API latency by route" shows flat 200ms until 2026-03-07 15:20, then series of 5xx events and sudden drop in p50 reporting.
- Likely cause: frontend query to metrics-store returning empty series when Prometheus downsampled buckets changed (noticed label rename?).
- Repro (local): run promql: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le) -> returns empty intermittently.

Action items / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm Prometheus scrape uptime 2026-03-07 14:30-16:00 (SRE) -> Jordan assigned.
- [ ] Check metrics-store migration PR (PR#2748) for accidental label rename (Aisha).
- [ ] Add fallback in frontend panel to fallback to aggregated metric when route-specific missing (short-term patch).
- [ ] Notify customer with ETA and what we found (Kevin). Draft message: "we see intermittent metric ingestion gaps; collecting additional scrape logs; working on dashboard fallback, ETA 24h".
- [ ] Add automated alert for zero-series returns in key dashboards (threshold + runbook).

Notes / debugging logs:
- Query at 2026-03-07T15:26:12Z returned 0 samples for route tag but underlying host metrics existed -> suggests label/key mismatch.
- console-frontend logs show error parsing timeseries: "expected label 'route' got 'path'" in a few panels.
- Possible origin: metrics exporter change from ingress team (repo: infra/ingress-metrics), check recent commits 2026-03-06..2026-03-07.

Follow-ups (short):
- Jordan: confirm Prometheus Alertmanager logs + scrape status (assigned, due EOD).
- Aisha: review PR#2748 and ingress-metrics commits; post findings here.
- Maya: prototype Grafana panel fallback and add panel-level note pointing to OBS-1284.
- Me (Kevin): draft customer update and push to CS ticket, coordinate with SRE/ingress.

Scratch TODO list (personal):
- [ ] Add small PromQL snippet to run in support playbook for CS to self-check (if they ask).
- [ ] Add link to runbook: confluence:obs-runbooks/zero-series-handling
- [ ] After immediate fixes, schedule 30-min postmortem with ingress team + SRE + console (next week).

Random notes to self:
- Keep this doc informal; transfer final postmortem to confluence.
- If fix requires model of label mapping, propose a compatibility shim in metrics exporter (low-risk).

References: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/console-overview?orgId=1
Prometheus query example: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{path="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le)

Last quick-check: ran promql at 2026-03-09T09:05Z -> returns expected series (so intermittent). Keep watch for recurrence.
